title: Speaking-Clock Mamba: Phoneme-Conditioned State-Space Modeling for Visual Forced Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.18667v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual forced alignment (VFA) locates phoneme and word boundaries in a silent talking-face video given its transcript. Existing methods mainly enforce transcript order at the decoding stage, leaving the encoder without an explicit mechanism to anchor its temporally evolving representation to transcript progress. As a result, phoneme-specific evidence is blurred and alignment drift accumulates over long sequences. In this paper, we propose Speaking-Clock Mamba, which makes transcript progress part of the temporal recurrence. A selective state-space (Mamba) backbone is inserted between the visual frontend and the Conformer cross-attention encoder, and a Phoneme-Conditioned Selective Scan (PCSS) conditions its input-dependent step size on a supervised, structurally monotone speaking clock that estimates progress through the transcript. translated_title: 说话时钟Mamba：面向视觉强制对齐的音素条件化状态空间建模
translated_abstract: 视觉强制对齐（VFA）旨在给定转录文本的情况下，在无声的说话人脸视频中定位音素和单词边界。现有方法主要在解码阶段强制执行转录文本的顺序，导致编码器缺乏将随时间演化的表示锚定到转录文本进度的显式机制。因此，音素特定的证据被模糊化，对齐漂移会在长序列上不断累积。在本文中，我们提出了Speaking-Clock Mamba，它将转录文本进度纳入时间递归之中。我们在视觉前端与Conformer交叉注意力编码器之间插入选择性状态空间（Mamba）骨干网络，并通过音素条件化选择性扫描（PCSS）将其输入相关的步长条件化于一个受监督的、结构上单调的“说话时钟”，该时钟估计在转录文本中的推进进度。由于该骨干网络的因果与双向变体会产生互补性错误，一种免训练的选择（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Speaking-Clock Mamba，通过音素条件化选择性扫描（PCSS）将受监督且结构单调的“说话时钟”融入Mamba状态空间模型的时间递归中，使编码器表示显式锚定转录进度，从而提升视觉强制对齐精度并抑制长序列上的对齐漂移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Speaking-Clock Mamba, which incorporates a supervised, structurally monotone "speaking clock" into the temporal recurrence of a Mamba state-space model via Phoneme-Conditioned Selective Scan (PCSS), explicitly anchoring encoder representations to transcript progress to improve visual forced alignment and suppress drift over long sequences.
